verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a plugin system that lets developers create and publish their own custom extensions ('use community plugins or build your own'), built on an 'open plugin API'. A community marketplace of 113+ plugins shows that distribution works in practice. The evidence never mentions TypeScript typings, sample code, or in-depth API reference docs, and there is no independent hands-on confirmation of the developer experience. Missing for 10: evidence of typings, sample/starter plugins, detailed API reference documentation, hands-on developer corroboration.
